questions.prompt: UFC 334 is live tonight — Gane vs. Hokit, the arena roaring right now, and everyone's got a corner of the fight. Which scene sounds most like yours tonight?

options.text: Locked in on every round — I'm not missing a second of it.
Buzzing with the crowd — the big-night energy is the whole point.
Half-watching while I do my own thing — the fight's just background tonight.
Too much noise at once — the whole night feels loud and scattered.

questions.prompt: The mighty Pokémon are out in Pokémon Go tonight, and the hunt is on. When a hunt like that calls, where does it pull you?

options.text: Out the door — I'm chasing the mighty ones right now.
One careful look at the map, then I let it be — they'll still be there.
Calling a friend — a hunt like this is better together.
My head's already full — maybe tomorrow, when it's quieter.

questions.prompt: Twenty years later, a classic Nintendo DS puzzle game is officially coming back — Professor Layton returns in 2027, but the wait is years long and the old cases are right there tonight. How do you sit with a wait like that?

options.text: Already replaying the old cases — the wait is half the fun.
Happy to wait — good things take their time.
Impatient already — 2027 is too far away, I want it now.
Easing in slow — one puzzle a night until it's real.

questions.prompt: Rings of Power just claimed the No. 1 stream — the biggest fantasy night on, the fellowship on screen, and a long watch ahead. If someone handled tonight's watch-night drink for you, what would you want in your hand?

options.text: Virgin or hard — a big mug of spiced cider, made for an epic night.
Herbal tea, slow and warm — no rush, the episode can wait for me.
Something sparkling and cold — easy sipping through the long watch.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Magic: The Gathering is hiding Star Trek references in its cards — the five best and weirdest ones are all over the table tonight. What does a discovery like that sound like at your table?

options.text: Like lofi in the background while I sort through the cards slow.
Like friends geeking out — everyone pointing at a different reference.
Like quiet focus — just me and the hunt for the weirdest one.
Like too many references at once — I can't keep up with the weirdness.

questions.prompt: Superman: Man of Tomorrow is coming, but the studio hasn't even seen it yet — tonight the next chapter is still just out of reach. In the hour ahead, how do you want to feel while you wait for it?

options.text: Buzzing — already dreaming up the first scene in my head.
Calm and steady — it'll arrive when it arrives.
Cozy — rewatching the last Superman tonight instead of chasing glimpses.
Restless — I want a glimpse now, not someday.
